title: The French Connection
tagline: Cold pizza on the stakeout. Hot steak inside.
about: Two hard-nosed New York narcotics cops chase a French smuggling ring.
cue: Serve the steak frites when Charnier sits down to dinner while Popeye freezes outside with his pizza.
faces: Our corner, a January morning. Steam from the street, cabs at the kerb.
From the old port of Marseille to the East Side. Butter, wine and a slow fire, the way they cook on the quay. Window tables are kept for our regulars.
Chicken livers seared pink and flamed with cognac, blended with butter, shallot and thyme. Cornichons, warm baguette.
Frog legs sautéed in butter, garlic and parsley, lemon.
Onions cooked slowly to deep brown in beef broth, baked under a crouton and bubbling Gruyère.
Tuna, anchovy, green beans, waxy potatoes, egg and black olives in a mustard vinaigrette.
The Vieux Port, Marseille. The quay where our chef began.
Sirloin seared hard and rested, warm tarragon and shallot butter sauce, hand-cut potatoes fried twice.
Chicken braised slowly in Burgundy with lardons, button mushrooms and small onions.
Rockfish, red mullet and mussels in saffron and fennel broth. Rouille and croutons.
Vanilla custard baked in a water bath, chilled, turned out under amber syrup.
Apples baked under butter and sugar, turned out warm with crème fraîche.
Pastis and orgeat over ice, clouded with water.
Young Côtes du Rhône, half carafe. The full carafe 3.25.
Dark roast, black, with a square of bitter chocolate.
Prix nets, service non compris. Prices subject to change.
Copain, First Avenue, New York. Carte d'hiver No. 71. Closed December 25.
